guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: Timken is increasing its 2026 outlook, with full-year earnings per diluted share now forecasted to be in the range of $4.05 to $4.20 and adjusted earnings per diluted share to the range of $6.35 to $6.50. The company is planning for 2026 revenue to be up approximately 5.5 percent in total from 2025.
